summary: All plan requirements are implemented. Three primary features are present and wired: (1) bootstrap.py has PersistedPropagationPosture dataclass (line 265), _persist_work_dir_propagation_result (line 271) called after preflight (line 723) with atomic write, best-effort OSError handling, redact_audit_text on logs, and preservation of existing env-file entries; (2) status.py has _mount_propagation_check_payload (line 106) reading environ first then falling back to compose env-file, reporting unknown when neither source has the posture, wired into collect_service_status as mount_propagation check (line 274); (3) provider_readiness.py reads AWF_WORK_DIR_BIND_PROPAGATION from environ (line 941) and includes mount_propagation in readiness result (line 1012). All 12 planned tests exist: 7 bootstrap persist tests in test_bootstrap_part_004.py (lines 777-1003) including the previously-missing test_bootstrap_persist_called_after_preflight (line 911) and test_compose_recreate_uses_persisted_posture (line 958); 4 mount_propagation status tests in test_status_mount_propagation.py (covering environ, env-file, unknown, and environ-precedence); 2 provider readiness tests in test_provider_readiness.py (lines 119, 137). Two minor deviations from plan letter (but not plan intent): (1) _persist_work_dir_propagation_result always rewrites the three keys rather than conditionally skipping unchanged values—the timestamp always changes so the write happens anyway; (2) no explicit preflight-skip staleness gate, but plan's Detailed Design section explicitly states bootstrap always re-runs the preflight regardless of timestamp. Both deviations match the plan's stated intent.
